{{Quote|This is their opposition leader. Tholote B'Leph?|[[Goran Beviin]], to «[[Nom Anor|Udelen]]»|<ref name="PM" />}}
'''Tholote B'Leph''' was a [[Politics/Legends|politician]] who served as an opposition leader on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ter Abbes]] during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] agent [[Nom Anor]] hired [[Goran Beviin]] to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] B'Leph, whose [[Death/Legends|death]] resulted in a [[Standard year/Legends|year]]-long [[Ter Abbes civil war|civil war]].

==Biography==
===Political career===
During the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Tholote B'Leph was involved in politics on [[Ter Abbes]], a grim industrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located off the main [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]<ref name="PM" /> in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Ter Abbes system/Legends|Ter Abbes system]]</ref> While B'Leph was in power, he accepted bribes and became known for his excessive generosity in awarding government contracts. He later became the leader of the political opposition on Ter Abbes,<ref name="PM" /> though he did not abandon his corrupt practices.<ref name="CE" />

===The target of a subversive plot===
{{Quote|What did you have in mind?''"<br />"''I need a politician removed.''"<br />"''In power or not?''"<br />"''Does it matter? I want him dead.|Goran Beviin and «Udelen»|<ref name="PM" />}}
By the fifth [[Standard month/Legends|month]] of [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], [[Nom Anor]], an [[Intendant caste|infiltrator]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] species, had spent nearly two decades spying on the inhabitants of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] and destabilizing its political structure.<ref name="NGC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> In pursuit of these goals, he decided to incite riots across the planet Ter Abbes by [[Assassin/Legends|assassinating]] their opposition leader, Tholote B'Leph. As part of his plan, Nom Anor intended to hire a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior to evaluate the effectiveness of their methods and determine how useful they might prove for the Yuuzhan Vong's [[Yuuzhan Vong War|upcoming invasion]].<ref name="PM" />

[[File:AnorUnifyingforce2jc.jpg|left|thumb|290px|The death of Tholote B'Leph and the subsequent civil war on Ter Abbes were orchestrated by Nom Anor]]
On [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], [[Nom Anor]], operating under the alias «Udelen», met with the Mandalorian [[Goran Beviin]] to arrange the assassination of the politician Tholote B'Leph. Anor revealed that he wanted the politician assassinated a few [[Standard day/Legends|days]] before the next [[Standard month/Legends|month]]'s elections on Ter Abbes. In exchange, he offered one hundred thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and promised that, if he was satisfied with the results, he would provide Beviin and his Mandalorian comrades with additional lucrative contracts. For Beviin, interfering in politics was work better suited to [[Spy/Legends|spies]] and carried far more potential trouble than he could handle alone. He knew that the assassination of the opposition leader would inevitably spark riots across the planet and briefly considered whether intimidating B'Leph by breaking his fingers, breaking one of his legs, or simply roughing him up would suffice. However, «Udelen» made it clear that he wanted nothing less than Tholote B'Leph's death. Despite his reservations, the promise of a substantial reward ultimately convinced the Mandalorian to accept the contract. Although Beviin was unaware of «Udelen»'s true motives, he concluded that his secretive employer was most likely involved in planning a coup on Ter Abbes.<ref name="PM" />

===Outcome of the assassination===
{{Quote|Goran Beviin did an efficient job of removing B'Leph, and a civil war is still in progress. He recruits equally efficient comrades: even their [Mandalorian] children are savage fighters.|Nom Anor's intelligence report to [[Prefect (Yuuzhan Vong rank)|Prefect]] [[Da'Gara]]|<ref name="PM" />}}
Eventually, Goran Beviin carried out Nom Anor's assignment with the required efficiency. The [[Death/Legends|death]] of Tholote B'Leph escalated tensions on Ter Abbes and resulted in a [[Ter Abbes civil war|civil war]]<ref name="PM" /><ref name="CE" /> that lasted for the following [[Standard year/Legends|year]].<ref name="CE" /> In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], eight [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the beginning of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|Yuuzhan Vong invasion]], Nom Anor sent an intelligence report to [[Prefect (Yuuzhan Vong rank)|Prefect]] [[Da'Gara]],<ref name="PM" /> the leader<ref name="NJOS">''[[The New Jedi Order Sourcebook]]''</ref> of the [[Praetorite Vong|first conquest force]],<ref name="CEI">{{CSWECite|I|161|Da'Gara, Prefect}}</ref> in which he emphasized the usefulness of the Mandalorians for infiltration, retrieval, assassination, and sabotage. Later that year, Nom Anor recruited a group of Mandalorian warriors led by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] to carry out [[Battle of Birgis|covert]] [[Battle of New Holgha|missions]] on behalf of the Yuuzhan Vong forces.<ref name="PM" />

==Personality==
{{Quote|What's he done?''"<br />"''He takes bribes.''"<br />"''No, I mean what's he done that all the others haven't?''"<br />"''He hasn't delivered on his promises.|Goran Beviin and «Udelen»|<ref name="PM" />}}
On the eve of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|Yuuzhan Vong invasion]], Tholote B'Leph occupied a prominent position in [[Ter Abbes]]'s political establishment as the leader of the planet's opposition party. While B'Leph was in power, he became known for his excessive generosity in awarding government contracts, accepting bribes,<ref name="PM" /> and was regarded as a corrupt politician.<ref name="CE" /> However, the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] of B'Leph prior to the election sparked riots across Ter Abbes and ultimately led to a [[Ter Abbes civil war|civil war]].<ref name="PM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tholote B'Leph was first mentioned in ''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]'', a [[2006]] [[eBook]] written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="PM" /> Later, he received a brief entry in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CE" />
